```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'INR'
),
handset_orders as (
    select o.order_id,
           max(p.storage_gb) as storage_gb
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join order_items i on i.order_id = o.order_id
    join products p on p.sku = i.sku
    where not o.is_test
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
      and p.model_name = 'Kestrel Onyx'
      and not p.is_accessory
    group by o.order_id
),
eligible_storage as (
    select h.storage_gb
    from handset_orders h
    join orders o on o.order_id = h.order_id
    where o.status = 'paid'
      and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by h.storage_gb
    having count(distinct h.order_id) >= 100
),
captures_ranked as (
    select h.storage_gb,
           a.order_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join handset_orders h on h.order_id = a.order_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
),
captured as (
    select c.storage_gb,
           sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as amount
    from captures_ranked c
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
      and c.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by c.storage_gb
),
refunded as (
    select h.storage_gb,
           sum(rf.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as amount
    from refunds rf
    join orders o on o.order_id = rf.order_id
    join handset_orders h on h.order_id = rf.order_id
    join payment_attempts a on a.attempt_id = rf.attempt_id
    join fx on fx.currency = rf.currency and fx.rate_date = rf.business_date
    where not o.is_test
      and not a.is_test
      and rf.status = 'processed'
      and rf.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by h.storage_gb
)
select cast(es.storage_gb as varchar) as key,
       cast(coalesce(r.amount, 0) / nullif(c.amount, 0) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from eligible_storage es
join captured c on c.storage_gb = es.storage_gb
left join refunded r on r.storage_gb = es.storage_gb
order by es.storage_gb
```
